verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents user-configurable 'Agent Flows' and 'custom agent workflows', and a built-in feature that automatically transcribes and summarizes meetings locally, so some automation exists. Nothing in the evidence shows these workflows can be scheduled, event-triggered, or left to run unattended in the background; the pack only shows that the feature exists. missing for 10: scheduled or triggered background execution of user-defined automations, documentation of how Agent Flows run autonomously, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
